body.message: 11am tomorrow works perfectly, Tammy. The DTCM fee is a Dubai Tourism tax on short-term stays and it's already included in the price, so nothing extra from you. On long-term, we don't do Ejari contracts, but you can stay as long as you like by renewing in 3-month blocks at the same rate. Could you send a photo of your passport or Emirates ID so we can get building access sorted for tomorrow?
